verses.text: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
He grabbed the dragon, that old snake, who is the devil and Satan, who fools the whole world. He tied him up for a thousand years.

He threw him into the bottomless pit, and shut and sealed it over him, so that he could not fool the nations any more until the thousand years were over. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

Then I saw thrones, and those sitting on them were given authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those whose heads had been cut off because they told about Jesus and preached the word of God. They had not worshipped the beast or its statue, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and ruled with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were over. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will rule with him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are over, Satan will be set free from his prison.
He will go out to fool the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gather them for battle. They will be as many as the grains of sand on the seashore.
They marched across the whole earth and surrounded the camp of God's holy people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and burned them up.
And the devil, who fooled them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will suffer pain day and night forever and ever.
Then I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The earth and the sky ran away from his face, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing in front of the throne. Books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged by what they had done, as it was written in the books.
The sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. Each person was judged by what he had done.
Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
